title: Multi-task deep learning on T2-weighted MRI distinguishes muscle-invasive bladder cancer
summary: A multi-task Inception V3 model using T2-weighted MRI alone was built to separate muscle-invasive from non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer. Accuracy was 0.911 in the retrospective test (390 cases), 0.923 in a prospective set of 39 cases and 0.846 in a 39-case multicenter set. The prospective and multicenter sets are small.
